lines.en: : Pay attention, Yasu! For this tutorial is not repeatable!
: I will do my best to not disappoint you, Master!
: Um...Molly? Why is Yasu suddenly calling you “Master?”
: Because, dearest Xessaxia, I have become her master! And have decided that it is in the best interest of the manga club if she takes after me in every way imaginable!
: With the one minor exception that she may continue to believe in her god as it was the one area she was not willing to budge on.
: It was an easy decision when every other aspect of me is unworthy and unlovable.
: But...you don’t know how to play volleyball, Molly. You don’t even go outside.
: Correct, Xessaxia! Which is why my first course of action is teaching Yasu how to adapt when she is forced to associate with normies!
: Molly! Just serve the damn ball! How long are ya plannin’ on makin’ us wait!
: You see, Yasu- sometimes, people will expect things of you that you simply cannot do! And, in moments like that, you must do your best to not let them down!
: So the only course of action is to create your own game! One not bound by the confines of what those unlike us expect!
: Is that...really the only course of action?
: This is not volleyball, Yasu! This is...demon ball!
: I don’t think I’m allowed to play this game anymore.
Futaba Fukuyama was one of just several girls currently engaged (or supposed to be engaged) in a casual game of beach volleyball.
And while athletics were certainly not her strong suit, she didn’t mind participating in things like this as the expectations placed on her were rather low.

It was a bit demoralizing, sure. But if there’s anything that anyone knows about volleyball in class-type settings, it’s that there will always be weak links who just try to avoid the ball at all costs.
And that was her!
But today, fate had other plans.
: ...and that’s how you play demon ball!
: I understand! May I attempt to expel evil from the ball’s nucleus now?
: Not before me, Yasu!
: Someone just serve the damn ball already! I’m freakin’ out over here!
: In the name of the Tuatha Dé Danann, I serve- no. I exorcise thee! Hah!
: THAT’S NOT EVEN THE RIGHT DIRECTION!!!
: F...Futaba! Look out!
: Huh?
: UWWWWAAAAAAAH!!!!!
: May your demons be exorcised!
: I don’t have any demons! I don’t even like-
Futaba is hit.
Futaba dies.
Futaba is reborn.
: Did it miss me?...
: Am I-
: What?...
: I didn’t...actually die...did I?...
: I know I’m not good at volleyball, but...
: No...of course I’m not dead. I’m...probably just unconscious or something. And this is a dream.
: But if it’s a dream...I shouldn’t know that it’s a dream...so-
: Look around you...
: What?! Who’s there?! Who said that?!
: You did...
There is no you in you and me but there is me in you
This normally ends differently, but different isn’t true
So lie until your tongue falls off and scream your favorite song
Then fill your hands with broken glass and squeeze until they’re gone
: It’s upside down...
: The current time is 11:19 PM. Today’s weather is expected to be complete within the next hour. Your name is Futaba Fukuyama. You are happy here.
: How...what...huh? Huh?!?!
: There are ghosts inside this building. They will attempt to speak to you. Do not look at them. Do not answer them. Do not pass go. Do not collect $200.
: Your attendance is requested for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium. Please come to the library for further details.
: Assistance will be provided if you can not find your egg.
: What egg?! What is this?! What are you talking about?!
: The egg that will guarantee your selection. The one that hums in your hand and not in your mouth. Assistance will be provided if you can not find your egg.
: I would like to wake up now...
: Hah...haaah....aaah! Yes! I’m cumming...again! Again! A...AAAAaaAAAaahhhh!
: Nodoka?...
: Do not...heed the call...
: Who is that?! Sh...Show yourself!
: No one...and nothing...
: Everyone...and everything...
: You are not safe here...they will claim you...they will complete you...
: Wha...what do you mean they’ll...complete me?
: You are...the unfinished you...the last silken thread...
: They will take you...tear you apart...learn how your body works...and you will become the model from which all else comes to fruition...
: I have no idea what that means! What is this place?! Where am I?!
: You know exactly where you are...
: A world atop your own...
: Just facing a new direction...
Futaba Fukuyama manages to complete the maze and eventually makes it to the library...but she broke several rules along the way.
The ghosts that followed her and lied to her became entities that she fooled herself into trusting. But each time she spoke back to them, she lost a part of herself.
These parts grew into additional Futaba Fukuyamas. Better ones. Ones that knew how to follow directions and saw themselves not as monsters but as angels.
They surrounded her, skin glistening in the anti-sun, and stared through her eyes and into each others.
Futaba Fukuyama (the original [[?]) felt intimidated by their presence. But, in a strange way, she found it easier looking at them than she did her own reflection.
These conflicted feelings were subsequently replaced by looming dread as a figure began to sprout in the corner of the room.
And while she could not see the figure yet as she fended off her shadows, it saw her. And it cried, for that was all it knew how to do.
It had existed in this space in time for as long as time had existed, and all it knew was pain. Scorn. It was the scapegoat the other ghosts would carve their names into. A scorned half-god.
And it watched in all its untapped fury as Futaba Fukuyama (the original [[?]) conversed with herself.
: What...How?...Why?...
: What does any of this even mean?...When am I going to wake up?...
: Here forever, special girl! No matter what you do!
: You can change yourself a million times, but you’ll never feel like you!
: Each time your fingers find your mouth, you give away a piece-
: Of sanity! Humanity! A chance to be complete!
She knew what they were saying because she wasn’t a fucking moron like you. She’d cleaned blood off her roommate, Occam’s, razor before and wasn’t perplexed by neglected complexities.
She was part of the codex — an abject auspex practicing breakneck safe sex, slipping objects in the convex annexes of each attic in the narthex.
She didn’t care about the effects. She paid no mind to things like that as she was too busy swimming in doubt and cum and more doubt and more cum and you were-
What were you doing?
I watched you last night. And I didn’t quite understand.
Please write your actions down on a piece of construction paper and slip it into my POx box so I can come closer to replicating you for my next art installment.
: X marks the praetor — a letter of love.
: The most shameful of angels in gardens above.
: You know the way out, you can still be complete
: You’re a fat fucking bitch but I’d lick both your feet.
: AHHHHAHHAHAHAHAHAH! LOOK AT THE LOOK OF HER LOOK! HER FEELINGS ARE CRAB LEGS INSIDE OF A BOOK!
: Okay...I think I might need to see a therapist. I am clearly broken. This isn’t normal.
: I’ll just...find this egg thing and...
It was then that she noticed the sprout that had sprouted. The flower of Eden in a forest so shrouded-
by evil and weevils, such a feeble upheaval! How depressing undressing for the cruelest of peoples!
: Hello?...
Futaba Fukuyama (the original [[?]) broke another rule. She spoke to the unspoken. She had doomed herself to a lifetime worth of unexpected taxes and a low-calcium diet.
She would also be brutally violated by at least one animal before leaving this place. But the animals were nice here so she probably wouldn’t mind it.
: Maybe it’s just a...statue?
: You-
: Ah!
: So you are terrified of me...
: What? No! I just...wasn’t expecting you to talk. You were so quiet just a second ago...
: So...you’re not scared?...
: I’m...a little scared of everything right now. I’ve never had a dream like this before. But you...seem nice?...
: Nice?...
: Yeah...everyone else is...being cryptic and...mean. But you’re just...minding your own business. So...thank you?
: You are...thanking me?...
: Yeah...but...it would also...be really nice if you could tell me what I’m supposed to do here?
: Did they give you a job?...
: I...I think so, but...but do you know who they are? And why I need an egg?
: They’re the ones who put me in here...
: They said my hands were too large. That I don’t look like the others. That I can not be completed...
: Just...because your hands are a little big?
: It’s hard for me to walk...I’ll only slow them down...
: So I’m better off in here...where I won’t be a burden to anyone...
: I like your hands...
: You do?...
: Of course...
: Because they’re yours...and because there’s nothing wrong with being a little different.
: Is that...really how you feel?...
: For everyone but me at least. Frankly, I wish I was a little more “normal” when it comes to the way I look.
: Are they going to lock you in here with me?...
: I hope not...
: It’s nothing against you. I think I just like my world a little bit more.
: Can you tell me about it?...What makes your world so special?...
: The people in it, mostly.
: I have a lot of people I really care about. And they’re really stubborn when it comes to trying to make me feel like I belong sometimes.
: It makes things...really hard, actually. But I do appreciate them for it. And I know their hearts are in the right place.
: These...people...they are humans?
: Yes, they-
: Is something wrong?...
: You...
: Look...different...all of a sudden...
: Different?...
: Yeah...
: That’s strange...
: I don’t feel any different...
: My hands are still too heavy to lift...
: Can you...tell me more about the people you love?...
: I wish...to love too...one day...but I...don’t know how...
: I have a better idea, actually...
: Why don’t you come with me? We can look for my egg together.
: But I...can’t walk...my hands...they’re too heavy...
: When was the last time you tried?
: Long...long ago...
: You’ve been here a while, huh?...
: I’m not allowed...to leave...
: I’ll scare...the others...I’ll be...the greatest burden known to man...
: These halls...are not meant for those like me...for those...not meant to be here...
: The incomplete...the abandoned...the scorned...
: If you won’t fit in here, all you really have to do is find a place where you will.
: Do places...like that...exist?...
: Come with me...we can find out together...
: Why are you...so nice to me?...
: Because everyone’s always nice to me.
: Well...maybe not everyone. But most people. And so the least I can do is repay that kindness.
: I can’t do it...
: Leaving here...will only hurt you...
: And you...do not deserve...that pain...
: What are you talking about? You’re not going to hurt me. Just take my hand and we can explore this place together.
: It is not me...who will hurt you...it is them...
: They are watching...they are here...
: There’s no one here but us. Everything is going to be-
: Hi! What’cha doing?
: Wha...is that-
: You shouldn’t touch that thing. It’s dangerous and ugly. How did it escape its chains, I wonder?
: ...Maya?
: Maya?...
: Who’s that?
: But even more importantly, who are you? You’re not supposed to be here. This area is for members only.
: Well, it’s not like I want to be here! I got hit by a volleyball and all of a sudden I was-
: 了解！家に帰ろう！
